ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% low-intensity (black) pixels across the central and medial regions, and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) core spanning the center and mid-lobes. High-intensity (white) contiguous blocks located at the far left and right distal tips. Transition zones between the black and white regions exhibit high-frequency stippled mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 140 degrees and a low bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Discrete larger indentations are visible on the distal half of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping laterally and dorsally towards acute, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, textured pixels at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicating heavy surface accretion/colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three distinct, parallel diagonal high-intensity linear marks located on the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable semi-circular 'C' shaped white mark on the mid-right lobe; distinct diagonal rake marks on the right lobe; irregular notch/indentation on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'C' shaped mark on the right lobe is a highly unique localized pixel cluster against the dark background.
